texts.en:
With so many implants able to control sensory and emotional experiences, augmented individuals have turned to virtual life events as escapism and entertainment. While engram artists can theoretically stimulate any emotion, the practice has taken a dark turn.

Memory engram clubs are paying top credits for self-recorded, intensely emotional experiences such as weddings and mating rituals, but also suicides, assaults, and murders. This has caused an uptick in crime, as criminals are both recording themselves committing offenses as well as stealing victims' implants after a traumatic experience.

How should we handle this concerning craze?

# 病态记忆 / Illicit Memories

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:4820-4925`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链后段：工作/家庭事件结束后隐藏事件 cyber.1000 从 on_futureshock_chain_leisure_events_list（7个事件，权重各5：休闲 1005/1010/1030/1055，社会 1205/1210/1255）抽取一个。
  Late part of the "Future Shock" event chain: after the work/family event hidden cyber.1000 draws one event from on_futureshock_chain_leisure_events_list (7 events, weight 5 each: leisure 1005/1010/1030/1055, society 1205/1210/1255).
- 无额外触发条件。
  No extra trigger.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「非法记忆」：选项——entertainment_crackdown、endorsed_entertainment、illicit_entertainment、decadent_entertainment，死亡崇拜者有 deadly_entertainment。
  "Illicit Memories": options: entertainment_crackdown, endorsed_entertainment, illicit_entertainment, decadent_entertainment; death cults get deadly_entertainment.
- 事件结束后180+随机90天由隐藏事件 cyber.1500 按政体权威选出最终事件 1505–1525 之一（跨故事的共享结局，视为枢纽）。
  After 180 days (+ random 90) hidden cyber.1500 picks one of the final events 1505-1525 by government authority (a shared ending across stories, treated as a hub).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
